name: JavaCI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:

jobs:
  ubuntu_build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [25]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v3
        with:
          java-version: 25
          distribution: "zulu"
          cache: "maven"
      - name: Build with Maven
        run: mvn -V -ntp clean install -P full verify
